performance.driver: Revenues increased $29 million for the three months ended May 1, 2026 as compared to the same period in the prior year primarily due to revenues from the acquisition of SilverEdge Government Solutions ("SilverEdge") of $19 million and ramp up in volume on existing and new contracts, partially offset by contract completions.

Operating income for fiscal year 2026, decreased by 28%, or $64.3 million, compared to fiscal year 2025, driven by inventory write-downs of $52.0 million, primarily of non-wrapper, dark air-cured tobacco, an increase of $32.2 million from fiscal year 2025, and a $41.1 million non-cash, goodwill impairment charge, related to our Shank's operation.
